stations.title: Imran
stations.say: What did each tap use this year?

stations.title: The logger box
stations.text: Little memory, and a year of readings.

stations.title: Your scripts
stations.gap: Reads the whole year at once

captions: At Marrowfield, Imran wants a year of the logger's readings added up, tap by tap.
The little box by the tap runs out of memory reading the whole year at once.
You write scripts that read the log a line at a time and keep only totals, in three tasks.
Now the year goes through a line at a time, and the memory stays flat.
Same year of readings, same little box. Imran sees which tap uses the most.
